body:
Curated 10 FatBaby observations into EMILY/BACKLOG.md INTAKE QUEUE.

Items:
- Founder real-time, clarifying obs 23:34:xxZ: 'it parses our backlog to show the sprints and sub items' -- confirms the PARENA-backed graph tool parses EMILY/BACKLOG.md directly (sections=sprints, bullets=sub-items), not HEIMDAL. Not actioned. (2026-08-24T23:33:47Z)
- Founder real-time: 'can we make a parena backed tool to view the graph of our sprints?' -- wants a PARENA-built visualization tool for HEIMDAL/sprint dependency graphs (or backlog-section graph?). Not actioned, ambiguous which sprint system (HEIMDAL vs BACKLOG.md sections vs something else). (2026-08-24T23:33:42Z)
- Founder real-time, SARENA_NOTEBOOK: 'same functionality as jupyter but its going to have a compiler you know?' -- emphasizing it's a real compiled-execution notebook (PARENA compile+run per cell), not an interpreted-kernel Jupyter clone. Not actioned. (2026-08-24T23:31:08Z)
- Founder real-time, clarifying obs 23:29:xxZ ('build the parena apis as that'): 'but they will apply to SARENA_NOTEBOOK' + 'for the notes parts' -- the title-card/TYLER-affordance PARENA APIs are specifically for SARENA_NOTEBOOK's note-rendering feature, not a general PARENA API redesign. Not actioned. (2026-08-24T23:30:37Z)
- Founder real-time: 'so build the parena apis as that' -- build PARENA's own APIs (editor/plugin surface?) using the same title-card affordance pattern just confirmed for SARENA_NOTEBOOK/TYLER. Not actioned, ambiguous which API surface specifically. (2026-08-24T23:30:24Z)
- Founder real-time, SARENA_NOTEBOOK: 'that is the same affordance' -- confirming TYLER title cards and the notebook's title-card UI are literally the same reusable affordance/pattern, not two separate designs. Not actioned. (2026-08-24T23:30:15Z)
- Founder real-time, SARENA_NOTEBOOK UI inspiration: 'look at the tyler episodes' + 'they have all these weird title cards' -- wants the notebook's title-card UI to draw on TYLER's own episode title-card style/aesthetic. Not actioned. (2026-08-24T23:30:13Z)
- Founder real-time, SARENA_NOTEBOOK UI framing: 'whatever parena native title card ui you want' -- gives creative latitude on the notebook's own title-card UI design, PARENA-native. Not actioned. (2026-08-24T23:30:09Z)
- Founder real-time, SARENA_NOTEBOOK note-rendering mechanism: 'if you want to do a note you put some parena code to render the html of the note above' -- notes are themselves PARENA code that renders HTML, not a separate markdown mode. Not actioned. (2026-08-24T23:29:58Z)
- Founder real-time, SARENA_NOTEBOOK: 'there should be note rendering built in' -- markdown/text-note rendering alongside code cells. Not actioned. (2026-08-24T23:29:50Z)
